edits.prompt: Use case: lighting-weather EDIT. Edit the supplied pixel-art camp panorama to MORNING. Return one 4:1 panorama, same exact framing and landmark positions as input, no border or labels. Preserve every palm tree, island, rock, coastline and mountain silhouette in exactly the same coordinates. Preserve ground surface boundary at y=270/384 (70.3% height) and bottom soil band at 354/384. Only repaint illumination: soft pink-gold morning haze, pale peach sunrise sky with clouds retained in place, gentle rosy ocean reflections, softly lit warm sand. Keep hand-painted crisp pixel art, limited palette, no characters/furniture/text. Do not zoom, crop, stretch, move objects or redraw terrain geometry.

Sand surface starts at y=270/384; soil at y=354/384. Change ONLY lighting, sky colours and light sources: warm low orange sun, amber horizon, violet upper sky, lit windows and lanterns.
